title: Not recommended by this girl!
text: Not a fan. I got a few Medusa products that honestly seem like Halloween makeup and other was low end makeup product. Stuff I will never use because it's not part of my daily regimen but also on top of it being something I wouldn't put on my face to begin with. I do not recommend unless you absolutely hate ipsy and Birchbox, then you may like this type of subscription.
label: negative
